name: American Honda - Irving Parts Distribution Center - Irving TX

fieldNotes.truckGate: Two controlled truck gates confirmed in Street View 2025-05: a south driveway signed 'HONDA - TRUCK ENTRANCE ONLY' and a NE driveway signed 'NO ENTRY / EXIT ONLY'. Both have sliding chain-link gates and perimeter fencing.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth visible at either truck gate in Street View - the gates read as remote/badge-operated sliding gates. A small set-back utility/pump structure near the entry is not a gate booth. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Set true - truck gates exist with no visible guard shack, implying badge/kiosk/remote check-in. Moderate confidence.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: No dedicated paved waiting area outside the gate; the entry driveway apron is short.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved truck apron inside the gate along the east dock face provides inside queuing room.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The internal truck apron along the east face is long enough to hold 3+ trucks between the entry gate and the docks.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Distinct gates at different points of the property line: a dedicated entry gate on the south and a dedicated exit gate on the NE - clearly signed.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: One inbound lane at the truck-entrance gate.
fieldNotes.exitLanes: One outbound lane at the exit-only gate.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock bank on the east building face with trailers backed in along most of the building length; door total estimated ~30, in the 25-50 band. Mid-size 1980s-era PDC.
fieldNotes.dropArea: A row of trailers parked in a staging/drop area at the NE of the property; estimated 10-25 stalls.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Loading concentrated on a single east-face dock bank - shipping and receiving not on physically separate dock clusters.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense Irving/Las Colinas industrial-office corridor near DFW Airport, fully surrounded by city development - Urban.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: One Honda PDC warehouse plus an attached/adjacent office building on the same property - a single facility. buildingCount=2 counts the warehouse and the SW office building.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-staging/drop area at the NE of the property, separate from the active dock apron.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~19 acres derived from the perimeter box - estimate; no published acreage found.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: Estimate from the NE staging area plus apron - approximate.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
fieldNotes.location: Roster coords (32.911717,-96.99072, APPROXIMATE) landed in the Las Colinas office/residential district. Resolved to 4525 W Royal Lane, Irving TX via web research; satellite and Street View confirmed the warehouse with 'HONDA' signage on the building and gates.

citations.claim: Active American Honda Stock and Material Handler (Irving TX) warehouse req at 4525 Royal Lane, Irving 75063.

verification.rationale: Active Tier-1 careers req tied to the exact American Honda PDC address; no closure/WARN/relocation. Not the independent David McDavid dealership warehouse.
